ActorTalk: Now, we each hold one end with one hand.
Ready for the real piece, Conductor?
Conductor, listen. Don't they sound like gentle raindrops falling from the sky?
Falling on both of us, letting us share the same rain.
When the sound appears, the warmth of touch—it all becomes part of the music.
When I choose to move closer to you, it creates a different kind of melody—
A secret "code" only you and I can understand.
